Chapter 728 - 728 Danger Of The Four Seasons Universe; Trouble!

Chapter 728 - 728 Danger of the Four Seasons Universe; Trouble!

728 Danger of the Four Seasons Universe; Trouble!

News of what had happened in the Summer Territory quickly spread throughout the Four Seasons Universe, and discussions surged like a tide.

“Have you heard? The entire Summer Territory has been attacked!”

“I heard that too. It seems to be done by the ocean universe!”

“How dare the ocean universe? Aren’t they afraid of our Four Seasons Universe retaliating?”

“Counterattack! We, the Four Seasons Universe Masters, will definitely stop the army from retaliating against them!”

“That’s right! Let the ocean universe know how powerful we are!”

“Revenge!”

….

At this moment, many higher-ups of the Four Seasons Universe gathered in the universe palace.

Among them was the lord of the Summer Territory, who looked extremely disheveled.

When the higher-ups saw him, they all asked.

“Master of the Summer Territory, what is the situation now?”

” How strong is the ocean universe?”

….

” This attack was too sudden,” sighed the ruler of the Summer Territory.” They definitely planned it beforehand. I was caught off guard. Now, the Summer Territory…I’m afraid it’s about to completely fall!”

Although everyone had already guessed this outcome.

However, after hearing the words of the ruler of the Summer Territory, he could not help but feel shocked.

” Let’s go see the universe master,” said Summer Territory Master.”

At this time, the universe palace’s door slowly opened.

A masked man holding a golden scepter walked out.

When everyone saw him, they all bowed and said,”Greetings, Grand Elder.”

” The universe master isn’t in the palace,” the great elder said.”

There was a slight silence.

Everyone had a bad feeling.

The universe master wasn’t here.

Then, the Four Seasons Universe was attacked by the Ocean Universe.

This… This was definitely a premeditated war!

Could it be that the universe master had already…

When everyone thought of this, their hearts could not help but accelerate.

Universe masters were the pillars of the universes.

If anything happened to him, the entire universe would be like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.

” Don’t worry,” the great elder said.” The universe master is still alive. At least, his life tablet is still intact. He’s just trapped somewhere.””

Hearing this, everyone heaved a sigh of relief.

This was not bad news.

“Now, let’s discuss how to organize an army to resist the ocean universe.”

“Yes, sir!”

A grand cosmic war began.

War represented chaos and slaughter.

It was even more so in space wars.

It was bloody and terrifying to the extreme.

Countless planets were reduced to hell, and some even turned into ashes.

Trillions of humans lost their lives.

….

In the blink of an eye, 50 years had passed.

For cultivators, 50 years was just the blink of an eye.

To the Four Seasons Universe, these 50 years felt like an entire era.

The power of the ocean universe had exceeded the Four Seasons Universe’s estimation, causing the Four Seasons Universe to retreat.

Finally, the ocean universe stabilized the Summer Region and took the initiative to attack the Spring Region.

Although the Spring Field was also resisting.

However, the effect was like an ant shaking a tree. It was completely useless.

Every day, a large number of planets were occupied by the ocean universe.

….

At this moment, at the edge of the Spring Field, on Earth.

“Phew!”

Lin Fan heaved a sigh of relief.

A cool breeze caressed the entire Earth.

In 50 years, Lin Fan had obtained 35 Transcendence Golden Bodies, 21 Immortal Crystals, 12 King Grade Equipment, 7 cultivation techniques, 6 Emperor Grade Equipment, and 2 Great Dao Fragments from the system.

These treasures allowed Lin Fan’s cultivation speed to grow faster and faster, allowing him to reach King level 5!

Lin Fan muttered,” On average, it takes 12 years to break through. That’s still a little slow.””

He was dissatisfied, so he could not help but curse Taijun.

One million Spiritual Stones instantly turned into ashes.

Cultivating for a long time was sometimes boring.

Stepping out, Lin Fan came before the Path-Understanding Tree.

When everyone saw him, they all shouted happily.

“Lin Fan!”

“Hubby!”

“Brother!”

“Master!”

….

Lin Fan nodded,” Not bad. Your cultivation is increasing very quickly.””

Now, Xia Bing and Xia Xue’s cultivation had already reached domain lord level 7.

Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Huang Ling and the rest also broke through to domain lord level.

Qin Menghu, Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann had all reached the Star-Grade.

Such a breakthrough speed was truly astonishing.

When everyone heard Lin Fan’s praise, their faces broke into smiles.

Lin Fan said,” If you have any questions about cultivation, you can ask now.””

Everyone scrambled to ask questions.

Over the past 50 years, Lin Fan had helped them solve their cultivation problems.

Each time, their cultivation path became smoother and smoother, allowing them to quickly increase their cultivation.

….

Just as Lin Fan was answering everyone’s questions…

A huge starship was approaching from afar.

Inside the starship, the man with the crab head stared at the huge display screen and said,””Oh? They found another planet. It was blue and looked like a gem! It was too beautiful! It should belong to our ocean universe!”

“It belongs to the ocean universe!” Cheers were heard in the starship.

Obviously, they all liked this blue planet very much.

Then, the man with the crab head suddenly pressed the red button in front of him.

“Whoosh!”

Immediately, a dazzling laser beam shot towards the blue planet.

However, before the laser beam could reach the blue planet, it was blocked by an invisible protective shield.

….

“Boom!”

With a loud bang, the earth shook.

Lin Fan, who was still explaining the problems of cultivation to everyone, suddenly stopped.

Then, he slowly raised his head and looked at the endless void.

He easily saw the situation outside.

All these years, Lin Fan had never left Earth.

However, he also knew the situation outside.

This was because he would also interact with Ma Zheng when he was free.

Lin Fan knew that this ship was an invasion ship from the ocean universe.

Now, the invading ships of the ocean universe were as terrifying as demons in the Four Seasons Universe.

Everyone was terrified.

However, Lin Fan’s face did not show any fear at all.

In Lin Fan’s vision, everyone on the starship was covered in countless weaknesses. He could take them all out with a casual strike.

“You guys sit here for a while. I’ll be right back.””

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan’s body flashed and he disappeared from where he was.

Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Huang Ling, and the others did not know what had happened.

However, they were all smart people and quickly guessed that Earth was in trouble again.

Every time there was trouble, Lin Fan would solve it.

They couldn’t help but clench their fists, thinking,’I have to become stronger and help Lin Fan share the burden!’
